results.original_title: Big Top: A Flying High Circus Story
results.overview: The FSU Flying High Circus was devastated when a tornado blew down their tent. Before they can return to shows, they must rebuild what students refer to as their “home away from home.” Their comeback story is filled with laughter, passion, and collaboration.

results.title: Becoming Bird
results.overview: This time-lapse documentary condenses the entire 21-day development of a chicken – from fertilised egg to the hatching of the chick – into a nine-minute film. In microscopic detail and in full colour, we observe the early stages of life within the fragile shell, which so often cracks prematurely at the hands of humans seeking to satisfy their base appetites.

results.title: ¿Qué es el cine?
results.overview: A series of video essays in which critic Alejandro G. Calvo explores fundamental questions regarding cinematic language, seeking to uncover the value of the image in the present day. Eschewing orthodoxy and academic didacticism, the series aims to understand the significance of cinema through key films and directors. It moves away from conventional criticism to offer an open, evolving reflection on the nature of emotion in the art of film.

results.title: No Way Back
results.overview: Three years after the apocalypse, Germany has fallen under the control of a ruthless new regime. In a world overrun by the dead and ruled by the merciless, Antonio, a broken survivor haunted by loss and betrayal, struggles to find a reason to keep going. But as the ghosts of his past refuse to fade, he discovers that the greatest threat isn't the dead wandering the earth — it's the people who are still alive.

results.title: Our Blue Youth
results.overview: Sharpshooter Xiang Qian meets top student Qin Feng. The two clash nonstop, from dorm brawls to shooting range duels, even competing over cafeteria meals: they sneak chili sauce into each other's food to make them tear up, and their midnight streaking is once live-streamed to the whole campus by a drone. Soon, Sanda martial arts queen Guan Yue and tactical whiz Ye Yu get dragged into the chaos. The four go from pranking and bickering to trusting each other with their lives, ultimately taking bullets for one another at a drug raid site.
